title: syncHistory
responsibility: Runs one explicit fetch, push or sync of history refs with a named remote.

inputs.name: syncHistory.action
inputs.description: Selects the HistorySyncService method to run and is used directly as its name, so it must be 'fetch', 'push' or 'sync'.

inputs.name: syncHistory.remote
inputs.description: The git remote to exchange history with; it must be a remote of the repository at root, or the call rejects with the message "<remote>" is not a remote of this repository. Defaults to 'origin'.

inputs.name: syncHistory.root
inputs.description: The directory whose git repository is used; it is resolved to an absolute path before the remote check. Defaults to process.cwd(), evaluated on each call.

inputs.name: renderSync.action
inputs.description: The action whose result is summarized, with the same values as syncHistory.action. Only 'fetch' omits the trailing clause, which is '; sent to <remote>' or '; nothing sent to <remote>'.

inputs.name: renderSync.result
inputs.description: The Synced value to summarize. renderSync reads its evidence, notes, pushed and remote fields, and pushed alone selects between 'sent to' and 'nothing sent to'.

outputs.name: syncHistory
outputs.description: Resolves with the Synced value from the HistorySyncService method named by action, run for the remote named by remote. It rejects instead when remote is not a remote of the repository at root.

outputs.name: renderSync
outputs.description: Summarizes a Synced value as 'Evidence <evidence>, notes <notes>' followed by a period. For any action other than 'fetch', the clause '; sent to <remote>' (when result.pushed is truthy) or '; nothing sent to <remote>' (when it is falsy) comes before that period, where <remote> is result.remote.
examples: Evidence created, notes fast-forwarded; sent to origin.
Evidence unchanged, notes absent; nothing sent to upstream.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised by fail() in syncHistory when GitAdapter.attempt(['remote', 'get-url', remote]) returns a falsy result, with the message "<remote>" is not a remote of this repository. Because syncHistory is async, the caller receives it as a rejected promise.
